subject: Biology
source: Phase F · FEAT-PF1 — author-original scaffold rows for the highest-volume Edexcel Y10 biology spec points (1BI0).

sentenceFrames: The mass of the potato cube changed from ______ g to ______ g.
Water moved ______ the cells by osmosis, because the surrounding solution had a ______ water concentration.

wordBank.definition: movement of water across a partially permeable membrane down its concentration gradient
the difference in concentration between two regions

stepLadder: Calculate the change in mass (final − initial).
Divide by the original mass and multiply by 100 for percentage change.
Decide the sign (positive = water in, negative = water out).
Explain the direction of water movement using the term 'water concentration'.
Use 'osmosis' and 'partially permeable membrane' in the explanation.
commonPitfalls: Dividing by the final mass instead of the original.
Forgetting the sign of the percentage change.

sentenceFrames: Father's genotype is ______. Mother's genotype is ______.
Probability of cystic fibrosis is ______ out of 4 = ______ %.

wordBank.definition: the set of alleles a person has (e.g. Ff)
the observable trait, e.g. 'has cystic fibrosis'
two identical alleles (e.g. FF or ff)
an allele that only produces its trait when homozygous (ff)

stepLadder: Decide what each capital and lower-case letter stands for.
Split each parent's genotype into two possible gametes.
Combine each father gamete with each mother gamete into a 2 × 2 Punnett square.
Read off the offspring genotypes and count which ones show the disorder.
State the probability as a fraction and as a percentage.
commonPitfalls: Mixing up dominant and recessive alleles.
Reading the Punnett square as 1 in 3 (forgetting the four cells).
Confusing genotype (Ff) with phenotype (no cystic fibrosis).
